reason: The warehouse photos and a written quote with every fee are what I need before I trust anyone with shop money, so I would try one small 1688 order as a test. But at 13,000 IQD a kilo by air, my cost per piece on cheap clothes is too high to make it my regular supplier route.
objection: If half a bulk order comes wrong, fake or damaged, do I really get my money back fast, and will the driver even find my shop? No change-of-mind returns scares me when I am buying 20 pieces of something I have never touched.
would_change_my_mind: A lower per-kilo rate for bulk or heavier orders, or a slower cheaper shipping option, so my landed cost per piece makes sense for resale.
